extractions.extraction_text: Paredes y techos(3) que separan al sector considerado del resto del edificio, siendo su uso previsto: (4) - Sector de riesgo mínimo en edificio de cualquier uso

attributes.norm_statement: Fire resistance for walls and ceilings separating a minimum risk sector from the rest of the building is not permitted below ground level.
attributes.applies_if: ELEMENT.TYPE IN ['WALL', 'CEILING'] AND SECTOR.RISK == 'MINIMUM' AND LOCATION.LEVEL == 'BELOW_GROUND'
attributes.notes: The text 'no se admite' implies a prohibition for this specific condition.

extractions.extraction_text: Paredes y techos(3) que separan al sector considerado del resto del edificio, siendo su uso previsto: (4) - Sector de riesgo mínimo en edificio de cualquier uso

attributes.norm_statement: Walls and ceilings separating a minimum risk sector from the rest of the building must have a fire resistance of EI 120 for above-ground plants, regardless of evacuation height.
attributes.applies_if: ELEMENT.TYPE IN ['WALL', 'CEILING'] AND SECTOR.RISK == 'MINIMUM' AND LOCATION.LEVEL == 'ABOVE_GROUND'
